__field_docs.key: Unique sample identifier. Used as the output sub-directory name (e.g. './outputs/success/<key>/'). Must be unique across the input list.
__field_docs.src_path: Source image input for the edit. Three accepted shapes: (1) a string path to a single image for ordinary image editing; (2) a list of string paths for multi-reference editing where the model conditions on several reference images at once; (3) null for text-to-image (T2I) generation, where there is no source image and only the edit_prompt drives the result.
__field_docs.edit_prompt: Natural-language instruction describing the desired edit / T2I prompt. Drives generation, evaluation, reflection and multi-step decomposition.
__field_docs.edit_path: Path to the image produced by your own unified model (the candidate output you want to evaluate / improve). If non-null, the pipeline copies it as the direct-edit result and scores it directly, skipping the initial Gemini call. Set to null to let the pipeline generate the first candidate from scratch.
__field_docs.edit_key: (Optional, free-form) Any metadata you want preserved in result.json (benchmark name, sub-category, original prompt, etc.). NOT consumed by the pipeline; just copied through to the output.
__field_docs.explanation: (Optional) Extra context shown to the knowledge evaluator, e.g. real-world facts the edit must respect. Empty string if not needed.

__comment: Example 1 - image editing: src_path is a single source image; edit_path points to your unified model's edit of that image.
edit_prompt: <Describe the desired edit, e.g. 'Replace the cat on the sofa with a golden retriever, keep the background unchanged.'>

edit_key._note: Free-form. Put anything you want preserved in the output result.json.

__comment: Example 2 - text-to-image (T2I): src_path is null since there is no source image; edit_path is your unified model's T2I output (or null to generate from scratch).
edit_prompt: <T2I prompt, e.g. 'A red panda sipping tea on a bamboo balcony at sunset, watercolor style.'>

__comment: Example 3 - multi-reference editing: src_path is a list of image paths; edit_path is your unified model's output that combines them.
